items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: professional film production ARCHITECTURE / LOCATION REFERENCE SHEET, one location only, nine separate architecture views arranged in a very clean 3x3 grid. Create a high-resolution landscape 16:9 image, request 3840x2160 if supported. Crisp fine detail and legible short uppercase labels in the thin neutral dark gutters, not across the image panels. Cinematic gritty realistic neon world of CyberKitty 2077, rich physically plausible materials, believable film sets, restrained pink/cyan accent lighting, no painterly blur. All nine panels must depict ONE spatially coherent empty environment with exactly the same doors, walls, lighting, floor, props and architectural landmarks in their correct corresponding positions; use a common north orientation. Panel arrangement: top row HERO WIDE, NORTH, EAST; middle row SOUTH, WEST, PLAN; bottom row CEILING / SKY, FLOOR / MATERIALS, REVERSE WIDE. Hero and reverse are useful empty stage camera plates. Plan is a crisp overhead architectural floor/site plan with N arrow and camera marks A and B at the hero/reverse positions, matching the renders. In the ceiling panel show ceiling features and hanging lights, or for exterior show upper facades and skyline. In floor/materials show floor detail AND a few isolated fixed prop material details. Do NOT depict any people, animals, characters, silhouettes, audience, security officers or portraits. No scenes, action, comic panels, movie frames or character sheets. No CRT television shell around the design. Empty filming stages. Avoid arbitrary decorative clutter and repeated random signs. Do not show conflicting geometry or mirrored landmarks. Readable title at top exactly as specified; all other labels short and clear. Title: "LOC08 / DISTRICT 7 MARKET". References 1 and 2 are for the established district's street materials, warm lantern stalls and distant cyan/magenta towers only; remove all their crowds and heroes. Design an empty gritty neighborhood market street at night just after rain: wet repaired asphalt and concrete, compact food stalls with rusted corrugated awnings, old red lanterns, cat icon signage, stacked empty fish crates, shuttered shop units, drainage channels and overhead power cables. Proposed coherent geography: long east-west market street, north row of warm lantern fish stalls, south row of lower shuttered shops and a short loading bay, west street mouth opens toward a small rally plaza, east end frames distant neon towers. A compact stair on the northeast building leads to a modest flat rooftop overlook; keep the same building/stair in east/north/plan views. Clear central street wide enough for a small refrigerated delivery truck later, but NO VEHICLES in this sheet. Stalls are closed/empty awaiting filming, no visible food stock that would contradict the shortage. Show empty counters, freezer cases, loading handcart and crates as fixed prop details. Weathered lived-in district, street scaled for anthropomorphic cats, not a sleek wealthy district. The reverse wide looks west toward the plaza so scene23 rooftop and market coverage can be established later.

notes: Clear empty market, warm lantern stalls, shuttered shops, plaza connection, overhead plan and materials.
Camera A/B in generated site plan are not a reliable match to hero/reverse orientation; use images as visual references and redraw authoritative camera marks before blocking.
qa.production_use: Ready as location design reference; camera marks and exact cross-angle geometry need final blocking check. Actual resolution is 1672x941, not 4K.
